spans.s: दय् vt. 1Ā (pp. दयित; pres. दयते) 1. To pity, to have compassion for, to sympathise with, (with a gen.), रामस्य दयमानोऽप्तावध्येति तव लक्ष्मणः Bt.viii.119, ii.33, xv.63; 2. to protect, नगजा न गजा दयिता दयिताः Bt.x.9; 3. to love, to like, Bt.x.9 (the first दयित); 4. to go, to move; 5. to give.
दया f. Sympathy, compassion, pity, mercy, tenderness, R.ii.11, Bg.xvi.2.

दाय m. 1. A gift, a present, अस्वामिना कृतो यस्तु दायो विक्रय एव वा M.viii.199; 2. a nuptial present given to the bride or the bride-groom; 3. delivery, handing over; 4. share, portion, inheritance, patrimony, अनपत्यस्य पुत्रस्य माता दायमवाप्नुयात् M.ix.217; 5. dividing, distributing; 6. loss, destruction; 7. irony; 8. site, place.
दया-कूट m. an epithet of Buddha.

दया-वीर m. the sentiment of heroism based on compassion, i.e. the sentiment of chivalrous compassion (in rhetoric). The following is an instance of दयावीर- न कपोत भवंतमंतरा स्पृशतु श्येनसमुद्भवं भयम् । इदमद्य मया तृणीकृतं भवदायुःकुशले कलेवरम् R.G.
दयालु a. Compassionate, kind, tender, R.ii.3, 52.
दयित (I) a. (f. ता) Beloved, desired, Bt.x.9.
दयित (II) m. A husband, a lover, दयिता दयिताननांबुजं दरमीलन्नयना निरीक्षते Bh.V.ii.182.
दयित (I) a. (f. ता) Beloved, desired, Bt.x.9.
दयिता f. 1. A wife, Bh.V.ii.182; 2. a mistress; 3. a woman in general.
दयिता-अधीन a. henpecked.
दाय-अपवर्तन n. forfeiture of inheritance.
दाय-अर्ह a. claiming inheritance.
दाय-आद m. 1. an heir, one entitled to a share of partimony, दायादानां न तद्भवेत् Yaj.ii.118; 2. a son; 3. a kinsman (near or remote).
दाय-आदा, -आदी f. 1. an heiress; 2. a daughter.
दाय-आदा, -आदी f. 1. an heiress; 2. a daughter.
दाय-आद्य n. 1. inheritance; 2. the state of being an inheritor.
दाय-काल m. the time of the partition of an inheritance.
दाय-बंधु m. 1. a partner in the inheritance; 2. a brother.
दाय-भाग m. division of property among heirs, partition.
दायक a. (f. यिका) Giving, bestowing, M.ix.271.
दायक a. (f. यिका) Giving, bestowing, M.ix.271.
